text:
morgan: Quick heads-up — aiming to cut the cross-repo roll tomorrow 09:00 PT (merge window 09:00-10:30). Sequence: api -> sdk -> console -> helm -> runtime. Need approvals and a green CI for each.

sam: I can do api reviews early. Which PR is the breaking header change?

morgan: api PR is https://git.company/api/pull/811 — it adds the optional `x-client-provenance` header and tightens auth checks. console depends on the new header to pass feature flags.

jess: noted, I have console #129 open but can't merge until api is in. I'll queue a quick follow-up to remove the old header fallback.

kai: SDK #342 depends on the api shape as well. I added a compatibility toggle but would prefer to merge sdk after api to avoid runtime mismatch.

morgan: yep — plan is merge order: api/811, then sdk/342, then console/129, then helm chart bump (charts/runtime v2.4.1), then runtime canary. If anyone needs a different order speak now.

sam: fyi tests flaked on auth e2e earlier — I retriggered. deploy-bot: CI status for api/811?

deploy-bot: api/811 — CI: ✅ all checks passed (unit/integration/e2e), coverage unchanged.

jess: console/129 — one flaky jest test, retrying. I can fast-follow the merge after api is green.

kai: sdk/342 — requesting @morgan for approval on the compatibility toggle change. Also calling out that runtime will need a tiny schema patch to accept the new header in router.

morgan: approving sdk/342 now. @qa_lead can you schedule a quick smoke for the runtime canary at +15m after helm deploy? want to validate KV cache behavior with new header routing.

qa_lead: Yup — will run the smoke script and sanity prompts. Can we pin canary to a single shard?

morgan: yes, will pin to shard-3, 50 requests/min for 10 minutes. If errors >= 2% rollback.

sam: after merges i'll open a tiny follow-up to update client docs and add the header to examples.

jess: once console merges i will lift the feature flag in prod after 30m observation.

kai: note for release notes: include sdk semver bump and migration step (clients should not rely on old header fallback).

morgan: thx all. final checklist before 09:00 PT: 
- api/811: approvals (sam + morgan) ✅
- sdk/342: approvals (morgan) ✅
- console/129: jess to merge after api ✅
- helm: chart bump PR created (helm/runtime#58) — need one approver
- runtime canary smoke: qa_lead scheduled

If anything blocks, drop a note here. otherwise i'll start the merge at 09:00 PT and call out individual merges as they happen. :manual_clock:
